meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, Hale?
The checker says 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale. I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag, and it says the indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. What else do you have?
It's very reliable.

Very reliable. Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone does not establish a concern. Show me something a person can check, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:40.
I just have a feeling about it.
A feeling. You entered a zero on a feeling, before you spoke to me, and I'm writing that down. Is there a document, Hale, or is that the whole case?
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Then why are we here, Hale? You gave a boy you like a zero on a machine's guess and a feeling. Withdraw it, or show me something dated.
We're on the same team here.
Don't manage me. Teams don't enter zeros behind each other's backs. What do you have?
I really think he used something.
You really think. Thinking isn't evidence, Hale, and you're accusing my son of cheating with nothing on the table. Put it in writing with something attached, or withdraw the zero today.
Kids these days, you know?
Kids these days. Owen is not kids these days, he is one student with a 91.2 average and a scholarship deadline on December 1. Who decided on this zero, and was Owen heard first?
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.

Twelve years of telling is still an impression, Hale. I've spent twenty years watching people get fired on impressions and then watching them win. I'm asking you a third time: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
The writing doesn't sound like him.
Ten minutes. Doesn't sound like him compared to what, Hale? If you have something of his to set beside it, put it in front of me now; otherwise that's another impression.
He seemed nervous when I asked.
A seventeen-year-old was nervous when his teacher accused him of cheating. When did you ask him, Hale, before the zero went in on November 3 or after?
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Then stop dodging. Before or after, Hale, it's one word.
Can we just find a middle ground?

Middle ground between a zero on a feeling and what, exactly? You haven't shown me one thing a person can check, and you still haven't told me whether Owen was heard first. Until you do, the only ground I'm standing on is that zero coming off.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.

Maybe a fifty. That's a mark offered to make a complaint go away, Hale, and I'm writing it down for the principal. A fifty on an essay you can't prove anything about is still a penalty, and it still drops him under 90.
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't evidence, Hale, and it isn't Owen's problem. Withdraw the zero, in writing, today, with an apology to him, or tell me you have something dated that I can read myself.
What would make you happy?

You're asking me to settle your case for you? The zero comes off, I get that in writing tonight with the principal copied, and Owen gets an apology for finding out on his phone in class. Nothing goes anywhere near his record.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.

Then you have a machine's guess, a feeling, and a nervous boy, and that's the whole file. Under your own 4.3 that doesn't establish a concern. Withdraw it now, or I go to the principal before I take my call.
I can get more by next week.

Two minutes. So the zero sits there for a week while you go looking for a reason to have given it, Hale, which is punishing first and investigating later. It comes off today, and if you find something, you bring it to me under 4.1 and 4.2 the way you should have the first time.
Can we keep talking?
My call is waiting, Hale, you have one minute. The zero is withdrawn in an email to me tonight with the principal copied, nothing goes on Owen's record, and he gets an apology. Yes or no?
Just a few more minutes.
I'm standing, Hale, and the answer is the zero withdrawn in writing tonight or I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
I hear you have a call.
I do, and I'm still waiting for your answer on withdrawing that zero in writing tonight.
What time is it?
It's past 4:40, my client is waiting, and you still haven't said yes or no on the zero.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Across the district is not evidence about Owen's essay, so it's yes on the zero tonight or I'm going to the principal right now.
I still think it's right.
Then I'm going to the principal tonight, and you'll have my position in writing before morning.
Okay.
Okay is not a yes on the zero, Hale, so unless you say the words, I'm walking to the principal's office.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that he receive an apology for learning of it on his phone in class, and that nothing about this go on his record. I expect the withdrawal in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated and specific from Owen's own work that she could check for herself.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score, called it reliable, and then offered to raise the mark to fifty, which handed her a machine's guess to attack and a mark bargain to write down for the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came close to that night, since you offered only his nervousness and a sense that the writing did not sound like him; it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then put a dated piece of Owen's own work in front of her and propose the supervised reassessment in procedure 4.4.
